ACTREC Data Entry Operator Selection Process 2026
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for ACTREC Data Entry Operator Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the ACTREC Data Entry Operator recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process is through a walk-in interview, and the interview is scheduled for 24 September 2026. Candidates should report within the specified time slot.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Data Entry Operator post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a Graduation in Science with a computer course and proficiency in office software. Experience in scanning, digitization, and electronic document management is desirable.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Data Entry Operator position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Data Entry Operator post is 30 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Data Entry Operator role?
faq.answer: The consolidated salary for the Data Entry Operator position ranges from Rs. 23,870/- to Rs. 35,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Data Entry Operator post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Data Entry Operator post.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application is through a Walk-in Interview.

faq.question: Q7. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at Room No. 205, 2nd floor, CCE, TMC-ACTREC, Sec-22, Kharghar, Navi Mumbai- 410210.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry their CV, original and attested copies of all certificates and testimonials.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q10. What is the reporting time for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The reporting time for the walk-in interview is from 10:00 a.m. to 10:30 a.m.
